mutants_note: Plan mode runs no scripts. No mutant was run. No kill rate is given.
fail_reasons: assertion_strength 6 is below the floor of 7 (must-fix).

findings.evidence: Phase 3 (plan line 152) tests `export --out FILE` only by its stdout line `wrote 2 rows to FILE`. No test reads the file. A mutant that writes no bytes passes. Add a test that reads FILE and compares it with the header and the two rows in CRLF form.

Phase 3 (plan lines 149 and 150) names the stdout content in prose only: `prints the header and the October rows`. The spec does not name the exact expected text or line ends. Phase 4 (plan line 171) checks the smoke output `by eye`. Name the exact expected stdout for the October case and the all-rows case, and assert equality in the test.

Assumption G-8 (plan line 95) says argparse errors for unknown options keep argparse text, and says `Phase 3 tests` settle it. No Phase 3 test in plan lines 149 to 155 or 205 to 255 covers an unknown option. The logged assumption names a test that the spec does not define. Add one test for an unknown option, or change the settled-by column.

Plan line 211 requires that a wrong month never reads the ledger. No test asserts this order. A mutant that reads the ledger first passes the spec. Add a case where the ledger file is malformed and the month is invalid, and expect the month error.

Plan lines 207, 251 and 252 define three tests with the same assertion shape: stderr `error: cannot read ledger`, no Traceback, return 2. Each differs only in the ledger content. Prefer one parametrize table of bad ledger contents, as the plan does for the exception classes.

Plan line 80 adds `Ledger.expenses(month)` as a filter that parallels `total_by_category`. Both methods repeat a filter-and-sort structure. The Reuse section does not name a shared helper. This matches the review note core:dry-extension. It does not change the verdict.
